title: Add Optimize suggestions API contract (schema + pagination/sorting)
author: Chloe Martin
description: Context: Console is adding a new Suggestions view (beta) under Optimize. This PR introduces the backend API contract the Console will consume: endpoint shape, response schema for savings + risk, and server-side pagination/sorting. Scope is intentionally contract + plumbing only; RBAC enforcement and the compute job that populates suggestions land in follow-ups (ENG-19377 / ENG-19455). API: GET /v1/optimize/suggestions Parameters: org_id (required), project_id (optional), environment (optional), route_id (optional), model (optional), suggestion_type (optional: batching|caching), risk_level (optional: low|medium|high), sort (optional), limit (default 25, max 100), cursor (opaque). Sorting: sort=estimated_savings_usd_per_day:desc (default), risk_level:asc, confidence:desc, stale_as_of:desc. Pagination: cursor-based (stable, opaque) backed by (sort_key, suggestion_id) to ensure deterministic ordering even as suggestions are recomputed. Stable IDs: suggestion_id is immutable for a given (org, project, route, model, suggestion_type) tuple; versioning is expressed via updated_at + stale_as_of rather than changing IDs. Response shape (abridged): {"data":[{"suggestion_id":"sug_01HP...","suggestion_type":"batching","scope":{"org_id":"org_...","project_id":"proj_..."},"target":{"route_id":"rt_...","route_name":"/chat/completions","model":"llama-3.1-70b-instruct"},"estimated_savings":{"usd_per_day":"42.10","percent":"18.2","token_volume_window":"24h"},"estimated_impact":{"latency_delta_ms_p50":"+12","latency_delta_ms_p95":"+38"},"risk":{"level":"medium","reasons":"Higher concurrency variance; p95 may regress during burst traffic.","guardrails":"Enable canary rollout and cap max_batch_tokens to 4096."},"confidence":{"level":"medium","inputs_missing":["cache_prefix_hit_rate"],"notes":"Derived from last 7d traffic; low samples for long prompts."},"stale_as_of":"2026-02-02T18:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-02-02T18:05:12Z"}],"page":{"next_cursor":"eyJz..."}} Errors: consistent with existing API error envelope (code/message/request_id). Notably: 400 for invalid sort field, 403 for authn/authz (authz wired in next PR), 429 for rate limiting (defaults aligned with Console read endpoints), 5xx for upstream DB/timeouts. Implementation notes: - Adds OptimizeSuggestionsService interface + repository query with server-side ordering. - Cursor encoding uses URL-safe base64 JSON blob; validated and signed (HMAC) to prevent tampering. - Query uses composite index (org_id, project_id, sort_key, suggestion_id) to keep p95 low; falls back to updated_at ordering when sort=stale_as_of. - Includes a compatibility adapter to map internal enums to API strings (risk_level low/medium/high, suggestion_type batching/caching). Testing: - Unit tests for cursor encode/decode, invalid cursor, and deterministic paging across inserts. - API integration tests covering sort fields and filter combinations. Follow-ups: - RBAC scope optimize:suggestions:read + audit log hook (ENG-19377). - Compute pipeline job + staleness semantics (ENG-19455). - Add "assumptions" block for UI details drawer (kept out of v1 contract to reduce churn; will add behind a feature flag once copy is finalized).
commits: api(optimize): define SuggestionsResponse schema (savings, impact, risk, confidence, stale_as_of)
db(optimize): add suggestions query w/ cursor pagination + sort mapping
security(api): sign/validate pagination cursor to prevent tampering
tests(optimize): integration coverage for filters/sorting/pagination edge cases
docs(api): add OpenAPI annotations + example responses
review_conversation: Jada Williams: Cursor-based pagination looks good. Can you confirm ordering stability when stale_as_of changes between requests? Chloe Martin: Yes; cursor includes both the resolved sort key and suggestion_id. If stale_as_of updates between page fetches, the next_cursor continues from the last seen tuple; some items may move earlier/later on a fresh query, but paging remains deterministic and avoids duplicates within a single traversal. We document this as "best effort" and recommend the Console refresh list rather than infinite-scroll for long sessions. Felix Schneider: Please add max limit guard + explicit error for unsupported sort fields so the UI can surface a helpful message. Chloe Martin: Added max=100 and 400 with code=INVALID_SORT_FIELD; tests included. Kaitlyn Nguyen: Since RBAC is follow-up, can we at least thread org_id/project_id through a single authorization boundary? I want to avoid accidental cross-tenant query paths. Chloe Martin: Repository requires org_id and always includes it in WHERE; project_id is optional but still scoped by org_id. Also added a defensive assertion in controller to reject missing org_id. Logan Wright: Confidence.inputs_missing is helpful. Can we standardize property names with telemetry aggregates (snake_case vs camelCase)? Chloe Martin: Kept API camelCase consistent with other v1 endpoints; internal mapping handles snake_case aggregate fields. OpenAPI example updated to match. Approvals: Jada approved after cursor doc tweak; Felix approved after validation changes; Kaitlyn approved with note to block merge of console feature without ENG-19377; Logan approved.
release_notes: Internal (beta): Adds /v1/optimize/suggestions API contract for Console Suggestions view, including savings/risk schema and cursor pagination. Not user-visible until feature flag + RBAC are enabled.
